roles: Exactly frozen O22P/O22Q 12 train FIT episodes (399 original selected actions), four already-seen internal FIT checks (150 selected actions); NEVER describe these checks as unseen future validation or protected science.
public_legal_effects: actual selected-action source-public next front blocked binary

independent_control.discounted_beta: Separately coded per selected (action,current_front) Bernoulli Beta posterior with prior pseudocount (1,1) and fixed chronological forgetting coefficient 0.92. Forgetting prior itself must NOT be decayed.
independent_control.cumulative_beta: Identical features and prior, but no temporal forgetting, comparable to frozen O22Q simple action+front.
independent_control.phase_only: Chosen action + episode step phase (0-7, 8-23, 24+) but no front history; tests crude elapsed-time confound.
independent_control.reversed_fit_order: Learn same events and labels, but reverse each authentic original episode's recorded selected-event order as a dependence-control, not new original source or equivalent on-policy learning.
independent_control.native_control: Unmodified source O22P NativePlasticCells, exactly same training history/feature set, and its fast=0 ablation after source training. Native surrogate is NOT original Ygg R2 integrated architecture.

predeclared_honest_interpretation: If original-native pooled accuracy loses to discounted conventional, native advantage refuted for this already-exposed in-sample comparison.
If original-native dynamic-front Brier advantage persists but discounted baseline closes it, stop native novelty hypothesis.
If native dynamic-front advantage persists against this single prereg alternative, label exploratory only; do not optimize on exposed checks or infer physical policy performance.
Chronological selected labels reflect changes in observations and moving world, not isolated causal intervention value of other actions.
No paid API, autonomous runner/controller modification, original R1–R12 edits, protected/DEV first-use, new model dispatch or merge.
